g.title: Personal memory, with a durable source of truth
g.text: Personal memory, with a durable source of truth
01 / SYSTEM VIEW One shared Python runtime · local SQLite · 1,000–10,000 active facts

g.title: cluster_ENTRY POINTS / both reach the same package
g.text: ENTRY POINTS / both reach the same package

a.xlink:title: Assistant or application | User supplies facts and questions | An LLM may propose typed operations | and phrase the returned evidence
a.text: An LLM may propose typed operations

a.xlink:title: One shared runtime | Python API: MemoryEngine | MMS skills → memory.py launcher | → memory_engine.cli (JSON interface)
Small, explainable results | Matching facts + why_matched | Source, confidence, status and dates | Search rank is separate from confidence
a.text: Search rank is separate from confidence

a.xlink:title: Resolve, validate, dispatch | Entity UUID, normalized name or alias | Unknown / ambiguous → explicit error | Validate predicate, value and UTC time
a.text: Entity UUID, normalized name or alias
Validate predicate, value and UTC time

a.xlink:title: Preserve fact history | remember · correct · lifecycle | Repeat → observation; change → supersede | Archive / forget: caller confirmation
Retrieve precise facts | lookup · history · at · related_to | changed_between · narrow answer() | Explicit subject / predicate / context
Rank existing candidates | Keyword: FTS5 / BM25 (default) | Optional local vectors / cosine | Hybrid: reciprocal rank fusion | Re-read SQLite with final filters

SQLiteStore · schema v1 | entities + aliases: stable identity | facts + observations: values / evidence | Validity, provenance, supersession links | BEGIN IMMEDIATE · WAL · foreign keys | Unique current subject/predicate/context
Search indexes & cache | fact_search: trigger-synchronized FTS5 | embeddings: fact + model + text digest | Local model files loaded separately
Back up, export, migrate | SQLite backup / restore to a new file | JSONL export / import into empty DB | Legacy layouts → backed-up migration | Exports omit derived search data
a.text: SQLite backup / restore to a new file
JSONL export / import into empty DB
